purpose: Preserve JPFM-2F-C1A as a fail-closed measurement pilot and localize separately (1) deterministic full-plate edge ineligibility for exact 81x81 stamps and (2) a polarity mismatch introduced only in the new intensity/moment estimator. This audit does not reinterpret C1A as PASS and does not alter the already-admitted B3S contour measurements.

failure_mode_1_transport_geometry.rule_that_failed: C1A required 64/64 full 81x81 stamps without shifting the frozen center.
failure_mode_1_transport_geometry.corrective_principle: For any future fixed-size stamp measurement, geometric eligibility must be computed from the frozen center, stamp size and named-plate NAXIS1/NAXIS2 before pixel access. Geometrically ineligible rows remain in the full denominator with an explicit status; their windows are never shifted inward and they are never silently dropped. Transport success is evaluated on the precomputed geometrically eligible subset, with all unexplained eligible-source failures retained as failures.

failure_mode_2_intensity_polarity.C1A_choice: The new central-signal/moment branch used I = 65535 - raw because upstream experimental profile_diff preconditioning in stage_shape_post.py uses this inversion.

facts: run_pass1 passes the reconstructed raw FITS image directly to Source Extractor; no 65535-minus-image preprocessing step exists in that detection call.
sex_pass1.sex specifies DETECT_TYPE CCD and DETECT_THRESH 5.0 on that raw image.

failure_mode_2_intensity_polarity.corrective_principle: The replacement direct central-signal and moment branch must use positive excess in the same raw-pixel convention actually presented to the upstream Source Extractor detector: signal = max(raw - outer_annulus_median, 0). The outer annulus, radii, moment aperture and SNR threshold remain frozen. This repair is limited to the new C1A intensity/moment branch; it does not alter upstream pass2 quantities or B3S contour formulas.

channel_separation_evidence.interpretation: Exact sparse named-plate pixels reproduce the previously admitted contour channel closely for transportable sources. The C1A failure therefore does not justify changing contour thresholds or formulas.

forbidden_repairs: drop geometric edge rows from the 64-row denominator
change the frozen 81x81 stamp size in the corrective replay
lower the central SNR>=5 gate after seeing C1A
change B3S or C1A contour thresholds 21,45
use nearest-source search or peak recentering
reveal nuclear, Blue Book, NUFORC, geomagnetic, lunar or solar temporal labels
